consequence.statement: Existing ClusterSecretStore objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration (re-write all objects) and update of status.storedVersions must be done before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all ClusterSecretStore objects and update status.storedVersions on the CRD before a later release removes v1beta1.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io CRD moves from v1beta1 to v1, so existing ClusterSecretStore objects remain stored as v1beta1 until rewritten and a storage version migration is needed before v1beta1 is removed.
